text:
Ana Park: Heads-up RFC follow-up: proposing a smaller queue surface and an "atomic enqueue" primitive to decouple scheduler topology from per-tenant batch shaping. want quick takes.
Liam Chen: +1 on decoupling. curious how this interacts with prefetch and KV-cache pinning though. does atomic enqueue imply stronger reservation semantics?
Ana Park: good q — idea is atomic enqueue returns a token that represents an in-flight reservation (not GPU slot). token can be used to attach KV entries or be redeemed against a slot. avoids scheduler poking into tenant internals.
Rachel Gomez: sounds promising for separation of concerns. we should define observability hooks for token lifetime and redemption latency. otherwise rolls will be hard to debug. :mag: 
Matt O'Neal: compatibility concern: existing batcher APIs assume enqueue == scheduling hint. migrating customers without a spike is important. can we support both surfaces behind a feature flag?
Ana Park: yes — plan: default old surface, opt-in experimental API `enqueue_atomic(...)` behind feature flag + telemetry. rollout: internal canary, then non-critical tenants, then all.
Liam Chen: edge case: long-lived tokens holding KV memory. need eviction path or TTL. suggest explicit `release_token(token)` and an automatic TTL with metric `token_unredeemed_count`.
Rachel Gomez: agree. also add rate metrics for token creation vs redemption to detect misuse. add a dashboard and an alert for redemption_ratio < 0.6.
Ana Park: pseudo API sketch: ```
// returns token id immediately
token = enqueue_atomic(tenant, req_meta)
// attach cached prefixes
attach_kv(token, kv_handles...)
// try to redeem into a slot
redeem(token, slot_constraints) -> success|deferred
release_token(token)
```
Matt O'Neal: migration steps: 1) gate behind FF, 2) keep old enqueue path that converts to token+immediate-redeem, 3) add gradual enforcement of token TTL, 4) deprecate old toggle after 3 months.
Liam Chen: performance tradeoff: extra indirection might add 50-150us on fastpath. is that acceptable versus cleaner topology? we should measure on microbench.
Ana Park: noted. target: <200us overhead p50. if exceeded, we can inline fastpath that short-circuits token for tiny requests (<= N tokens).
Rachel Gomez: also think about admission fairness: tokens could be hoarded by noisy tenants. suggest integrating with tenant credits and expose `token_priority` to admission.
Ana Park: yep policy will accept priority hint + enforce max outstanding tokens per tenant. default conservative.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary feature-flag rollout scheduled for 2026-04-08 18:00 UTC for eng-runtime/testbed.
Matt O'Neal: action items: ana to write short RFC with API + telemetry matrix; liam to prototype microbench for overhead; rachel to draft dashboards/alerts; i’ll own migration plan and FF lifecycle.
Ana Park: thanks — will post RFC link here when ready. :raised_hands:
